t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They pretty much said to look at the colours of the gnomes not like their hat or what they are wearing. I need to focus on the colours on each gnome in order to see what mushrooms they lead to. Some gnomes will lead me to a dark forest and some gnomes lead you to a bright forest.

vb_textbox.text: You will see some gnomes and you will have to choose based on the colour of the gnomes, which colour on average gives you the most mushrooms in the forest. For me i found a pattern between the orange, green, yellow and blue gnomes and got a good amount of mushrooms with those. You can test to see if it works for you, at times i also switched to the opposite of my chosen gnomes when i wasn't getting any points and that worked out well quite a number of times. So, make sure not to only stick to the gnomes i mentioned.
